ios.desc:
Scramble – Fast-Paced Word Solving
Swipe, tap, and scroll your way to the correct 5-letter word.

How to Play:
	•	Interact with a single letter using a specific gesture
        •	Scroll on the purple box, tap the egg, then swipe the purple box to finish
	•	Complete the full 5-letter word
	•	Finish as quickly as possible!

Think fast, act faster.
Download Scramble and crack the next word.

Launched my first couple of apps this year!

A scanner for pilots to convert handwritten flight logs to CSV files: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/flightlogscan/id6739791303

And a silly, fun, speed-based word game: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/scramble-game/id6748549424 (my record is <4 seconds lmk if you can beat it!)
